challenges.alt: Three Mars rover designs positioned together on a rocky test terrain.
challenges.title: Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars
challenges.summary: Tell young explorers the stories of hardware NASA has left on the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

challenges.alt: Illustration of Earth with four quadrants showing different global data layers, including weather, precipitation, land surface, and atmospheric patterns.
challenges.title: Be An Earth System Trend Detective!
challenges.summary: Visualize NASA observations over time to reveal where Earth is changing and whether those trends are significant.

challenges.alt: NASA Astronaut Christina Koch looking out the window at Earth.
challenges.title: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
challenges.summary: Create a game that lets students balance the power, food, shielding, and life support of a lunar or Martian outpost.

challenges.title: CLPS Lunar Mission Browser
challenges.summary: Help compare lunar landing sites and dates by visualizing sunlight and communication windows near the south pole.

challenges.alt: An astronaut performs a leg exercise while health data displays on a nearby monitor, with Earth visible through the window behind them.
challenges.title: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions
challenges.summary: Build software that helps astronauts track health indicators and respond to changes during long space missions.

challenges.alt: NISAR satellite illustration showing Mount Rainier on Nov. 10, 2025, with L‑band SAR revealing the surface through clouds.
challenges.title: Dancing with the SARs
challenges.summary: Use NASA–ISRO NISAR radar observations to visualize changes across Earth’s surface, from glaciers to forests.

challenges.alt: Nevada farmer Denise Moyle in her alfalfa fields.
challenges.title: Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data
challenges.summary: Combine NASA Earth observations with soil and crop information to help farmers explore resilient crop rotations.

challenges.alt: Image of a flame burning one of the BASS tests on extinguishing burning fuels.
challenges.title: Flame in Freefall: AI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data
challenges.summary: Turn NASA’s microgravity combustion research into an AI-powered dashboard for spaceflight fire safety insights.

challenges.alt: 15 - Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots_4.3
challenges.title: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots
challenges.summary: Combine MODIS and VIIRS fire records into a consistent calendar for examining burning activity and unusual conditions.

challenges.alt: A muted blue Earth with bright white clouds sets behind the cratered lunar surface.
challenges.title: Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars
challenges.summary: Find and characterize places on Earth that can help test future missions to lunar and Martian environments.

challenges.alt: NASA's Perseverance rover taking a selfie while exploring the Red Planet.
challenges.title: Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map
challenges.summary: Bring multiple NASA datasets into a layered Martian map to help astronauts plan routes and explore safely.

challenges.alt: Illustration of the SPHEREx spacecraft above Earth, set against a detailed cosmic background.
challenges.title: Planet X and SPHEREx
challenges.summary: Create a public tool to compare SPHEREx sky images over time and reveal objects that move or change.

challenges.alt: An astronaut performs a spacewalk above Earth, holding a large circular equipment panel while attached to the spacecraft.
challenges.title: Space Mission Design Game
challenges.summary: Design a game where students plan a complete space mission while balancing engineering choices and limited resources.

challenges.alt: A person stands in Space for Earth, an immersive experience that is part of the Earth Information Center, surrounded by glowing digital projections of Earth and vibrant green foliage with flowing light patterns on the floor.
challenges.title: The Earth Information Jukebox
challenges.summary: Pair Earth Information Center visualizations with live sonification to make Earth science an experience of sight and sound.
